description: This file contains Drupal media library UI behaviors, including selection management, AJAX content loading, tab handling, and accessibility features for the media library modal.

methods.name: updateMediaLibrarySelection
methods.description: Updates the current media library selection with media IDs from server response.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches behaviors for media library tabs, views display, item selection, and modal clearing.

methods.name: mediaLibrarySelectionCount
methods.description: Theme function that returns HTML for displaying the count of selected media items.
